checklist_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G-R - Provider-Neutral Market Data Rights Checklist
checklist_metadata.purpose: Evaluation of legal and contractual data rights for private forward-evaluation research

governance_principles: Private non-commercial quantitative research does NOT require an enterprise SaaS redistribution license.
Individual, developer, or brokerage client APIs are legally valid provided their Terms of Service permit internal analysis and local model evaluation.
No external network connections or automated data downloads may occur during this audit.
No sealed Tier 3 data (>= 2022-01-01) may be accessed under any circumstances.

candidate_providers_evaluation.private_research_permission: VERIFIED (Explicitly permits internal modeling, personal portfolio research, and non-redistributed algorithmic backtesting)
candidate_providers_evaluation.storage_and_caching_rights: VERIFIED (Permits local caching for subscriber's internal analytical purposes)
candidate_providers_evaluation.derived_data_rights: VERIFIED (Calculation of proprietary portfolio weights and indicators is unrestricted)
candidate_providers_evaluation.historical_vs_prospective: VERIFIED (Supports both historical EOD bars and daily prospective EOD feeds)
candidate_providers_evaluation.corporate_actions_coverage: VERIFIED (Provides split factor and cash dividend fields in canonical JSON payload)
candidate_providers_evaluation.redistribution_restrictions: RESTRICTED (Public posting of raw vendor price series is prohibited; private execution logs are permitted)
candidate_providers_evaluation.retention_terms: VERIFIED (Cached data may be retained for duration of active research)
candidate_providers_evaluation.revocation_policy: VERIFIED (Standard commercial terms; cached internal derived states remain subscriber work product)
candidate_providers_evaluation.evidence_of_authorization: CONDITIONAL (Requires human repository owner to input their valid TIINGO_API_KEY in local untracked config)
